sky arts.desc: Sex, Drugs and Rock and Roll: A look at America's changing morality during the 60s, from views towards sex and the use of drugs to a newfound expressiveness through music. (S1, ep 10)

sky arts.title: Discovering: Ian McKellen
sky arts.desc: A glimpse into the life and six-decade long career of Sir Ian McKellen, star of Richard III and X-Men, who has won many awards for his vast work in film. (S13, ep 6)

sky arts.title: Landscape Artist Of The Year
sky arts.desc: The last of the heats takes place in Worm's Head, Wales, where the artists have just four hours to capture the stunning coastal scene on canvas. (6 of 9)

sky arts.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
sky arts.desc: Vengeance Is Mine Inc: Mrs Wilbur gets more than she bargained for when she calls upon the services of Tom and George, two actors from New York who are hell bent on revenge. (S3, ep 4)

sky arts.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
sky arts.desc: A Girl Can't Always Have Everything: Struggling actresses Suzy and Pat meet Herbert, a wealthy widower. Seductive Suzy enjoys his money, but things soon don't look so rosy. (S3, ep 5)

sky arts.title: The Alfred Hitchcock Hour
sky arts.desc: To Catch a Butterfly: When a young couple moves into a new neighborhood, they find their lives and marriage threatened by the boy next door. (S1, ep 19)

sky arts.title: Guy Garvey: From The Vaults
sky arts.desc: 1978 Revisited: Guy returns to 1978, where the punk revolution is still alive with bands like The Undertones and Sex Pistols. Features interviews with The Fall and Magazine. (S4, ep 1)

sky arts.title: Jimi Hendrix: Blue Wild Angel
sky arts.desc: Live At The Isle Of Wight. New: Witness Jimi Hendrix's electrifying final UK performance at the Isle of Wight Festival, captured just weeks before his untimely death.

sky cinema premiere.title: Finnegan's Foursome
sky cinema premiere.desc: Two brothers and their adult children head to Ireland to honour their late father's final wish by scattering his ashes on a golf course. What starts as a clash of egos, old grudges and comic misadventures soon turns into a week of bonding and warmth.

sky cinema premiere.title: Splitsville
sky cinema premiere.desc: When his wife asks for a divorce, a man runs to his friends for support, only to learn that the secret to their happiness is an open marriage.

sky cinema premiere.title: Couples Weekend
sky cinema premiere.desc: Trapped in a cosy cabin by a blizzard, two couples ring in the new year with a mysterious cocktail that strips away their inhibitions, turning their romantic getaway into a showdown of secrets, betrayals and rapidly shifting loyalties.

sky cinema premiere.title: Reminders of Him
sky cinema premiere.desc: Released from prison, Kenna tries to reunite with her daughter, but her custodial grandparents refuse to let her see her. She soon finds unexpected compassion from a local bar owner as their secret romance gives Kenna hope for a second chance.

sky cinema action.title: The Patriot
sky cinema action.desc: A widowed farmer, with a brave but brutal military past, decides not to join up when the British arrive in 1776. However, when his son enlists and is later captured by the enemy, the former soldier must abandon his new-found pacifist principles in order to rescue his oldest child, and forms a regiment of Carolina patriots, whose guerrilla tactics prove pivotal to the US war effort.

Stylish historical epic retelling the fierce battle at Thermopylae in 481BC. The Spartan king, Leonidas, and his tiny army of 300 followers provided inspiration for the whole of Greece as they fought the massed ranks of the Persian army whose commander, King Xerxes, had up to a million warriors at his disposal.

sky cinema action.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
sky cinema action.desc: Greek Gen. Themistocles leads the charge to fight invading Persian forces led by the god Xerxes -- once a mortal -- and Artemisia.

sky cinema action.title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
sky cinema action.desc: Brixton Lorr is a cybernetically enhanced soldier who possesses superhuman strength, a brilliant mind and a lethal pathogen that could wipe out half of the world's population. It's now up to hulking lawman Luke Hobbs and lawless operative Deckard Shaw to put aside their past differences and work together to prevent the seemingly indestructible Lorr from destroying humanity.

sky cinema family.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
sky cinema family.desc: Master Wu, as wise-cracking as he is wise, leads a fierce team of secret ninja warriors to defeat the evil warlord Garmadon and save Ninjago City.

sky cinema family.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
sky cinema family.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of Kitty Galore who dreams of global domination.

sky cinema family.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
sky cinema family.desc: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

sky cinema family.title: Trolls
sky cinema family.desc: Poppy, the optimistic leader of the trolls, and Branch, her polar opposite, embark on an adventure that takes them far beyond the only world they've ever known.

sky cinema comedy.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
sky cinema comedy.desc: A champion NASCAR driver's cosy position alongside his best friend at the top of the championship is threatened by a flamboyant French newcomer. With his confidence shattered, the driver draws on the help of his father and some eccentric training techniques to claw his way back to the top.

sky cinema comedy.title: Yesterday
sky cinema comedy.desc: Jack Malik is a struggling singer-songwriter in an English seaside town whose dreams of fame are rapidly fading, despite the fierce devotion and support of his childhood best friend, Ellie. After a freak bus accident during a mysterious global blackout, Jack wakes up to discover that The Beatles have never existed. Performing songs by the greatest band in history to a world that has never heard them, Jack becomes on overnight sensation with a little help from his agent.

sky cinema comedy.title: Paul
sky cinema comedy.desc: On a pilgrimage to America's UFO heartland, two British sci-fi geeks meet an extraterrestrial and hatch a plan to help him return to his spaceship.

sky cinema comedy.title: Seven Psychopaths
sky cinema comedy.desc: A struggling screenwriter finds himself inadvertently entangled in the criminal underworld when his knucklehead friends abduct a mobster's beloved Shih Tzu.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Critters
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Hilarity and horror ensue when toothy, carnivorous aliens escape from their space prison, pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. When they reach the Kansas farmhouse of an all-American family, the humans do everything they can to fend off the critters, but they cannot free themselves of the ferocious outsiders.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: When Mike's 11-year-old sister sneaks out to reconnect with Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy, she sets into motion a terrifying series of events that reveal dark secrets about the true origin of Freddy's.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Men in Black 3
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Agent J goes back to the swinging 60s in a time-travelling mission to save his partner from a murderous alien.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Men in Black: International
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The Men in Black have expanded to cover the globe, but so have the villains of the universe. When aliens that can take the form of any human arrive on Earth, H and M embark on a globe-trotting adventure to save the agency -- and ultimately the world.

sky cinema thriller.title: Murder by Numbers
sky cinema thriller.desc: A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Hunt for Red October
sky cinema thriller.desc: Soviet and American forces give chase when the captain of a Soviet nuclear submarine sets a course for the Maine coast.

sky cinema thriller.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
sky cinema thriller.desc: John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Girl on the Train
sky cinema thriller.desc: A divorced train commuter passes the house she used to live in with her husband every day. To distract herself she creates a fictional perfect world for her former neighbours in her head. This is ruined when one of the neighbours goes missing.

sky cinema greats.title: Smokey and the Bandit
sky cinema greats.desc: Tongue-in-cheek tale about a high-speed car chase across America involving a sheriff and a bootlegger with crash stunts galore. All goes well for the Bandit as he drives from Texas to Georgia with a truckload of illicit beer until he stops to pick up a damsel in distress, who also happens to be the sheriff's daughter.

sky cinema greats.title: Blazing Saddles
sky cinema greats.desc: Irreverent spoof about a black sheriff hired by a crooked speculator to drive citizens out of an all-white town which lies in the path of a railroad. The townspeople turn on the inexperienced sheriff, and he is forced to turn to a convict, once the fastest gun in the West, for help.

sky cinema greats.title: The Witches of Eastwick
sky cinema greats.desc: Three frustrated female divorcees living in a quiet town wish for the perfect man to enter their lives. When a mysterious, rich and charming stranger buys a mansion in the community, it looks like their prayers have been answered - but the man they appear to have summoned seems more than a little devilish. Based on John Updike's novel.

sky cinema drama.title: True Grit
sky cinema drama.desc: John Wayne won an Oscar here as Rooster Cogburn, a lawman recruited by a teenager seeking revenge on her father's murderer.

sky cinema drama.title: A Star Is Born
sky cinema drama.desc: Hard-drinking country music star Jackson Maine discovers, and falls in love with, a struggling but talented singer named Ally. As her career quickly takes off, Jackson starts to realize that his best days may be behind him.

sky cinema drama.title: 28 Days
sky cinema drama.desc: A hard-drinking New York journalist takes her reputation as the life and soul of the party too far when she knocks over her sister's wedding cake and crashes the bridal limousine. When a court orders her into rehab for a month, she initially refuses, but eventually she begins to take her substance abuse seriously.

sky cinema drama.title: Terms of Endearment
sky cinema drama.desc: While widow Aurora fends off a stream of admirers, daughter Emma learns the hard facts of married life.
